value.rationale: A natural robustness question for the Goles–Olivos static period-two theorem is whether alternation of two equally simple undirected majority networks preserves it. A connected, cubic, bipartite, isomorphic snapshot construction produces all even divisorial periods up to unbounded 2m and, unusually, permits an entire exact attractor and transient census. The mixedness-factor mechanism and sharp transient-depth distribution make this a structural result, not a routine special-case count.
